name: FindingDogStory F02 gameplay open chest refinements

params.prompt: Generate an ORIGINAL simulated gameplay screenshot, 1024x768 4:3, of the confirmed opening of one salvaged expedition chest at the EXISTING GameDraft Wujin dock. Reference 1 is an actual GameDraft gameplay screenshot: preserve exact fixed high three-quarter camera, gray tiled shopfronts, stone quay, timber wharf, water on right and dark painterly texture. All humans remain 65-95 pixels high just like reference 1. Reference 2 is the exact original in-game inspection overlay art: round compass, four torn mountain-map pieces, silver coins and stitched book. Reference 3 is the original small timber-and-leather cargo chest sprite. The moment is AFTER opening: show one small cargo chest at Guan Ergou feet with its lid RAISED and interior exposed. At center place a dark translucent inspection overlay about half the screen width containing the exact reference 2 objects. Behind overlay keep enough original dock visible to read scene and scale. Top-left coin HUD and bottom-right item toolbar, small unreadable text fine. Absolutely game camera, not film camera. No Yin stone, no made-up structure, no giant person, no extra person. Put open chest on the stone quay near the dark-clothed player, left of center. Its raised lid should be unmistakable even behind the overlay. Do not show any closed chest or second chest.
params.negative_prompt: closed chest, flat shut lid, two chests, enormous chest, giant human, oversized character, cinematic camera, closeup portrait, added building, new shore, full-screen poster, fantasy stone
